scope: First circulation 2011-12-09; arXiv v4 2024-10-07. Opened full HTML, Lemma 4.3 and section 5; historical references followed through section 1. The publication date is not the date of the classical results.
Accessed 2026-11-19. Differential and tame ramification formulas checked.

Seminar 1960--1961; original publication 1971; corrected electronic re-edition posted 2002 and published as Documents Mathématiques 3 in 2003. Exposé IX, Theorem 6.1: original p.253, re-edition p.195. Full theorem and surrounding proof read.

Received 1978-08-02; Russian original 1979, Izvestiya 43(2), 267--276. Full English PDF opened. Section 1, pp.248--249; section 4, Theorem 4, p.255 and corollary p.256. No claim that the whole proof was formally verified.

Official TAC reprint record opened: Reprints in Theory and Applications of Categories 7 (2005), 1--195. Verification is bibliographic only: full PDF retrieval failed because of tool size/access limits. No uninspected theorem number is attributed to this book.
Version dated 2026-08-19. Opened chapters 4, 5.1 and 6.1, including root groups, rays and automorphism construction; software was not run. Original package implemented 2000.
Accessed 2026-11-19. Exact equivalence criterion: fully faithful and essentially surjective.

Opened full manuscript version 5.0 and publisher metadata. Theorem 1.14, printed p.45; Proposition 2.3, p.52; evaluation fibration pp.104--105; Theorems 8.1 and 8.8. Page references here refer to this opened version.

First arXiv circulation 2013-09-08; journal volume bears 2014 but publisher gives release 2015-04-27. Publisher full PDF https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/44274 opened. Theorem 5.7 and Corollary 5.8 p.366; Lemma 5.19, Proposition 5.20 and Theorem 5.21 pp.372--373.
Invited address 1972-11-25; received 1973-06-25. Full PDF opened; section 1.5, Theorem 1.5.2, p.217. Distinguish homotopical triviality and contractibility.

Exposé delivered February 1973; publication 1974. Full PDF opened; Theorem 1 and Remarks 2 and 4. This source gives a weak homotopy comparison for Homeo/Diff, not by itself all later contractibility claims.
Written January 1984. Full 44-page PDF opened; sections 2--4, printed pp.9--20, checked. Exact-image programme remains a question in the text.

First circulated 2026-03-03; v2 2026-11-05. Opened full HTML, especially section 4.2, Definition 4.3 and Theorem 4.5. COF and RGC are explicit extra conditions defining the Belyi--Grothendieck--Teichmüller reconstruction framework. Not evidence that unrestricted GT equals the absolute Galois group.

First circulated 2024-05-20; v2 2026-01-13; v3 2026-08-06. Full PDF opened. Section 1.3, pp.4--5, Remark 1.3; proven specified 2-power dihedral quotients and the assembled infinite quotient do not settle all proposed quotients or the full Ihara-surjectivity question.

Partial public transcription by Mateo Carmona with Matthias Künzer; edition date unspecified. 207-page PDF opened. Section 13, printed p.45; section 35, pp.150--152 (the proof explicitly stops at a centrelessness lemma); section 37, pp.184--186, especially formula (58). Several intervening sections have headings without complete text. This is not one of the unavailable named project returns.

First online publication 2015-09-07. Direct full-PDF and publisher opens repeatedly failed (502/access errors). Exact primary indexed text of Theorem 18, preprint p.17, retrieved: fixed hyperbolic type and unramified Galois covers of a prescribed Belyi pair. Marked unverified under the requested opened-link rule; Guillot supplies an independently opened all-regular-dessins theorem. First circulation of this particular final version not established.
